validity.note: Filename says '2025-2026' and the season table itself runs 15 Dec 2025 - 14 Dec 2026, i.e. covers essentially the full 2026 calendar year. No year mismatch concern here (unlike Pristine Mara Bay/Travellers Beach/Warm Sea Sand Villa) — the full 2026 year is genuinely priced.

structuralFindings: Rates are per ROOM (Single/Double), not per person — Single B&B = 1 person, Double B&B = 2 persons, each its own flat room rate.
Base meal plan is Bed & Breakfast only — no Half Board/Full Board/All-Inclusive option offered on this rate sheet at all.
Two room categories: Standard and Superior.
Three seasons: High (15 Dec 2025-28 Feb 2026), Mid (1 Mar-30 Apr & 1 Jul-14 Dec 2026 — two non-contiguous windows), Low (1 May-30 Jun 2026).
Extra bed rate is a flat B&B add-on split only by age bracket (3-11 yrs vs 12+ yrs), not by season or room category — same $95/$110 regardless of High/Mid/Low season.

Complimentary inclusions are notably generous for this rate: shared airport transfers on check-in/check-out dates, daily Lamu Town trips via the hotel's motorised dhow, and a welcome drink on arrival — all bundled into the room rate at no extra charge.
Rates stated as commissionable to Bonafide Travel Agents & Tour Operators — relevant for Sunworld's own commission structure.
Minimum-night stays 'may apply at certain times of year' but no specific nights/dates given — flag as an open question if booking during a likely high-demand window.
